name: UI：环节参数详情-多策略默认checkbox切换验证
description: 验证一个环节有多个策略时，默认checkbox是否支持多个同时勾选、切换交互、保存后状态持久化

steps.description: 打开链路详情(20180)
等待加载

steps.expression: (() => { const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')); const paramSpans = spans.filter(s => (s.textContent || '').trim() === '入参'); return { total: paramSpans.length, positions: paramSpans.map((s,i) => { const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); return { idx: i, x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.width, h: r.height, visible: r.y > 0 && r.y < window.innerHeight }; }) }; })()
steps.description: 获取所有'入参'span位置
至少2个环节有入参链接

steps.expression: (() => { const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')); const paramSpans = spans.filter(s => (s.textContent || '').trim() === '入参'); const target = paramSpans[1]; if (!target) return { found: false }; target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const r = target.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2 }; })()
steps.description: 滚动到首图生图环节的入参并获取坐标
点击首图生图环节的'入参'
等待弹窗渲染
弹窗标题验证
策略列表板块存在

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const wrappers = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')); const checkboxes = wrappers.map((w, i) => { const input = w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); return { idx: i, label: (w.textContent || '').trim(), checked: input?.checked ?? null, disabled: input?.disabled ?? null }; }); const checkedCount = checkboxes.filter(c => c.checked === true).length; const uncheckedCount = checkboxes.filter(c => c.checked === false).length; return { open: true, total: checkboxes.length, checkedCount, uncheckedCount, checkboxes, multiDefaultAllowed: checkedCount > 1, allChecked: checkedCount === checkboxes.length }; })()
steps.description: 分析所有默认checkbox初始状态
弹窗已打开
至少有2个策略(对应2个默认checkbox)
核心断言：多个策略可以同时勾选默认(非互斥)
初始状态：所有策略默认checkbox均已勾选

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const wrappers = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')); const firstChecked = wrappers.find(w => w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked); if (!firstChecked) return { found: false }; const r = firstChecked.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, label: (firstChecked.textContent || '').trim(), x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2 }; })()
steps.description: 定位第1个已勾选的checkbox
取消勾选第1个策略的默认checkbox
等待状态更新

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const wrappers = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')); return { states: wrappers.map(w => ({ label: (w.textContent || '').trim(), checked: w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked })), checkedCount: wrappers.filter(w => w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked).length }; })()
steps.description: 验证取消勾选后其他checkbox状态不变
取消勾选后剩余勾选数=总数-1

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const wrappers = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')); const unchecked = wrappers.find(w => !w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked); if (!unchecked) return { found: false }; const r = unchecked.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, label: (unchecked.textContent || '').trim(), x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2 }; })()
steps.description: 定位刚取消勾选的checkbox
重新勾选该checkbox
等待状态恢复

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const wrappers = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')); return { checkedCount: wrappers.filter(w => w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked).length, allChecked: wrappers.every(w => w.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')?.checked) }; })()
steps.description: 验证重新勾选后全部恢复
重新勾选后全部checkbox恢复为已勾选

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const btns = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button')); const cancel = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('取')); if (!cancel) return { found: false }; const r = cancel.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2 }; })()
steps.description: 定位取消按钮
点击取消关闭弹窗(不保存修改)
等待弹窗关闭

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const visible = drawer && drawer.offsetParent !== null && !drawer.classList.contains('ant-drawer-hidden'); return { drawerClosed: !visible || !drawer }; })()
steps.description: 验证弹窗已关闭
取消按钮可正常关闭弹窗

steps.label: stage-default-checkbox
steps.description: 多策略默认checkbox切换验证截图

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；链路id=20180存在；首图生图环节有4个策略
_testDesign.realDomNotes: ant-drawer弹窗；策略列表每项含'默认'checkbox；ant-checkbox-wrapper定位；checkbox为input[type=checkbox]
riskPoints: 多个默认checkbox是否互斥(实测：不互斥，可同时勾选)
取消一个后其他是否联动(实测：无联动，独立切换)
取消后点取消按钮是否正确丢弃变更(不弹确认框)
_testDesign.coreVerification: 一个环节多个策略时，默认checkbox支持多个同时勾选(非radio互斥)，每个checkbox独立切换，取消/保存分别控制持久化
